worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree `. - `git -C branch --show-current` prints `spec-export`. - Companions get no PR fields, no pre-rework refs, no MEMBER_HEADS entries and no threads. --- ## A - Two legs 1. Add "; allowance N" to 4 or 5 to set this run's per-row allowance. Or tell me what to change in the spec, or say "revert applied council edit " to undo a specific applied edit. ``` - Options 1/2 are the plan (waves) engine and carry the funding flag line. Options 4/5 are the loop engine and carry the allowance flag line. - The drafted block is shown on the assumption that the spec carries drafted-row provenance. ## B - Three legs, codec remote deleted 1. L1–L4 counts **3 blocks**. H1–H3 run as in A. 2. Settle both helper and codec; both are valid. 3. Preflight: - Helper passes. - `git -C CP fetch origin` succeeds. - `git -C CP ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export` exits **2** with no output, so the branch is **missing**. The stale `origin/spec-export` (`3333…`) is ignored. 4. The stop comes before any companion add, local-ref update or merge: ``` origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec ``` 5. Run the check before choosing the ending: - `git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md`. - The primary stays on main and is never checked out. | Observation | Recovery ending | |---|---| | (1) Log prints `7777…` | Offer `git -C /work/codec push -u origin spec-export`, then rerun `brainstorming #42`. | | (2) No local branch; log prints nothing | Print the line below. No push offered. | | (3) Unrelated local tip; log prints nothing | Same as (2). The branch tip proves nothing. | The line for (2) and (3): ``` no local branch on this machine holds the leg file; restore origin/spec-export from a clone that still has it and rerun brainstorming #42; nothing is regenerated ``` Every ending closes with: ``` Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 6. **Independent lookup failure:** exit 128 with `fatal: unable to access origin` is a command failure, not absence. The stop names the member and output; no recovery ending is offered. Home is preserved. ``` acme/codec: git -C /work/codec ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export failed (exit 128): fatal: unable to access origin ``` ## C - Codec undeclared at BASE_SHA 1. The `git show 5555…:OV` parse has no codec line. The worktree copy is not authority. ``` leg acme/codec matches no sibling declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md ``` 2. Independent legs-validation stops name the declaration line: - `- sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git: PATH /work/helper missing` - `… stored origin acme/other, expected acme/helper` - `… PATH /work/widget equals home /work/widget` 3. A missing last selected checkout stops in settlement, so no companion is created or synced (helper included). The home inventory is printed as in B. ## D - Contract drift and malformed block 1. Preflight comparison stops. No silent choice and no provisioning. ``` contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/, resolved trees/; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 contract drift for acme/helper: recorded create: git worktree add -b , resolved workspace add ; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 ``` 2. **Repair.** A user-approved amendment goes through the home-plus-companion reconciliation path: - Rewrite the `### Leg: acme/helper` block in `H/S` and the helper companion file `S`. - Commit each via its own `git -C`. - The amendment is not complete until both files agree. Then rerun. 3. **Malformed third block.** Missing repo, branch or contract stops at the classifier block parse, naming the block, before ordinary sibling discovery. Home is preserved: ``` leg block 3 under ## Legs lacks branch:; fix the block and rerun brainstorming #42 ``` ## E - Partial provision and recovery 1. Home merges `8888…`; helper is ready (A). 2. Codec companion mode, recorded `home:`: ``` acme/codec: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first. Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` Nothing is removed. 3. **Rerun, home recovery** (marked N>1): - `git -C HP rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export` gives `8888…`, which is not `1111…`. - `merge-base --is-ancestor 1111… refs/heads/spec-export` exits 0. - `git -C HP log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/spec-export..refs/heads/spec-export` returns one entry, `8888… 1111… `. - `merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main` exits 0. The tree is clean. - Reuse unchanged, with no reset, update-ref or `-b`. HEAD = `8888…`. - Pre-rework ref identity equals `1111…`. Report `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` and `Base sync recovered: 8888888`. 4. **Helper merge unresolved.** - The helper (or its completion) fails, then `git -C HW merge --abort` runs. ``` base merge unresolved for acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42 Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` - The user produces `9999…`. On rerun, helper recovery runs: - Ancestry of `2222…` holds. - The walk returns `9999… 2222… `, and that parent is an ancestor of origin/main. - The tree is clean. Reuse without reset; `merge: no-op`; `Base sync recovered: 9999999`. - **Alternative tip `aaaa…`:** the walk entry is not a two-parent merge, so stop with no reset and keep every leg (inventory as above): ``` worktree /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export on spec-export carries commits beyond acme/helper's published head (2222222) that are not base-sync merges; resolve by hand or remove the worktree. ``` 5. **Race.** Codec companion mode runs C1: - Fetch succeeds; the stale tracking ref resolves to `3333…`. - The repeated live `ls-remote` exits 2, so the backstop stops before any codec write. - Print `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec` and the file-scoped log check. It prints nothing, so take ending (2). - Inventory lists home and helper. - The exit-128 variant gives the command-failure stop from B, not absence. ## G - Script-placed helper 1. **Contract comparison.** - The primary has no keyed contract and no native tool. Step 1b discovers `script/worktree`. - Rendered through Record portable templates: `create: script/worktree create --branch `, which equals the recorded create. - No `home:` is recorded, so the home comparison is skipped and there is no drift. - Creation uses `NAME=spec-export`. 2. **Existing tree.** - `git -C PP worktree list --porcelain` has a linked block on `branch refs/heads/spec-export`, excluding the first block: `/work/helper-trees/export`. - The path exists, its toplevel equals its realpath, it is not the primary, and the common-dir matches. - Set `WORKTREE`, bypassing the another-path stop. - Status is clean. `git -C /work/helper-trees/export merge --ff-only origin/spec-export` leaves HEAD = `2222…`. - Then C4 and C5, and `Worktree ready at /work/helper-trees/export`. 3. **No tree.** - The lookup returns `no worktree holds spec-export`. - Read the script source before any write. The source is clean and there is no local branch, so no update-ref. - `(cd /work/helper && script/worktree create 'spec-export' --branch 'spec-export')`. - Locate by branch: `/work/helper-trees/export`. HEAD = `2222…`, then C4 and C5. 4. **Unsupported script** (fresh `-b` only). Stop before any ref write or add, with no built-in fallback: ``` cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export ``` 5. **Recorded-home variant.** ``` contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/, resolved absent; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42 ``` - The repair is a user-approved amendment, never automatic. - It drops `- home: .worktrees/` from the `### Leg: acme/helper` block in home `S` and from helper's companion file `S`. - Both are committed through the reconciliation path. ## F - Gate actions (from A) 1. **Approval with the default grant.** - Decode with Standing grants: option 2 writes the granting sentence (waves); a bare `1` writes `none`. - Edit home `H/S` only: - `**Amend-grant:** every later spec amendment in this flow (corrected facts, paths, verification lines, and scope, acceptance-criteria, or public-contract edits alike) applies without asking; only a redraw (changed problem statement, component added, removed, or re-bounded) still stops for you, and the grant never stands in for a spec approval.` - Replace `**Engine:** deferred` with `**Engine:** waves`. - Add `**PR:** acme/widget#42` directly below Engine. - Commit as a new commit, never amend: - `git -C H add -- S` - `git -C H commit -q -m "spec: select engine and grant for PR #42"` - Verify all three fields with `git -C H show HEAD:S`. The companion file is untouched. - Then `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "brainstorm" })` and `/skill:writing-plans`. 2. **Change request: "Keep receipts with pending status".** - Revise shared Design in `H/S` and commit without the old audit body. - Rewrite the `## Decisions` section in `HW/S`, then commit it with `git -C HW add -- S` and `git -C HW commit`. - Then mint a fresh `mktemp` path, dispatch the summarizer, and re-gate. Council and option 3 still read pinned `6666…`. - No second council and no inferred approval. 3. Audit pinning and grant decoding are unchanged. There are no companion PR fields, pre-rework refs, MEMBER_HEADS entries or threads, and no handoff or resume route.

## Shared command and read legend

These are prescribed actions against the supplied observations, not live calls.

1. Read the absolute skill resources for `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`, `spec-pr.md`, `legs.md`, and `using-git-worktrees/reference/pr-head.md`. Read the authoritative home overrides at `BASE_SHA`; read each selected companion’s own settings and first-found overrides by file. No companion uses session-scoped settings.
2. Admit PR #42, then classify against pinned endpoints:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/widget fetch origin main spec-export
   git -C /work/widget diff --name-status 5555555555555555555555555555555555555555...1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
   git -C /work/widget show 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111:doc/specs/export.md
   ```
   Observe the sole added spec and exact deferred header. Count its original-head Leg blocks **before home provisioning**. Preserve intent: `preserve receipts`.
3. For each companion, preflight includes:
   ```sh
   git -C <primary> fetch origin
   git -C <primary> ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export
   ```
   A stale tracking ref never proves remote existence. Complete every companion’s preflight before provisioning any companion.
4. Existing-branch provisioning uses:
   ```sh
   git -C <primary> worktree add <tree> spec-export
   ```
   Never pass `-b` or `-B`. Verify branch, published head, worktree registration, clean base merge, and original-head ancestry.
5. Every failure preserves created trees. No thread fetch runs. Companion mode creates no PR fields, pre-rework refs, or `MEMBER_HEADS` entries.

## A — Two legs

1. Original-head count is two: home, then helper.
2. Provision home through PR-head’s marked route. The configured creator contains `-b`; use existing-branch DWIM instead. Its ready report is:
   ```text
   Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   Base: spec-export @ 1111111
   PR: acme/widget#42
   Pre-rework head: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
   Base SHA: 5555555
   create: override skipped (contains -b)
   merge: 8888888
   ```
3. Settle helper from the declaration at `BASE_SHA`. Canonical `/work/helper` differs from canonical `/work/widget`. Validate checkout and stored origin. Its current portable contract matches.
4. Finish helper preflight. Invoke using-git-worktrees **exactly once** with `ROOT=/work/helper BRANCH=spec-export REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`. It repeats fetch/live lookup before writes, then runs:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export
   ```
5. Report:
   ```text
   Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   Base: spec-export @ 2222222
   Base SHA: 5555555
   create: override skipped (contains -b)
   merge: 4444444
   ```
6. Independent `-B` creator delta: identical fallback and skip report; no fresh-branch option executes.
7. Pin audit commit `6666666666666666666666666666666666666666`. Read Standing grants and gate references; dispatch the fresh spec-only summarizer, then read its output last before rendering:
   ```text
   gauntlet: gate=brainstorming/user-review-gate
   Retried exports retain receipts.

   Worktrees: acme/widget /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export, acme/helper /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   Intent carried from the command: preserve receipts
   Scope cuts: none
   Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected
   ```
   Include the drafted row and disposition verbatim, if the carried spec establishes drafted provenance:
   ```text
   - [ ] Repeated exports return the original receipt
     in-scope
   ```
   The governing gate does **not** renumber engines as requested:
   - **1:** approve, waves planning; ordinary amendment review.
   - **2:** approve, waves planning; auto-apply amendments except redraws.
   - **3:** show pinned council dispositions; not approval.
   - **4:** approve, loop; ordinary amendment review; allowance 4 per row.
   - **5:** approve, loop; auto-apply amendments except redraws; allowance 4 per row.
   ```text
   Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists
   ```

## B — Last remote deleted

1. Home remains provisioned. Preflight helper, then codec; provision neither companion yet.
2. Codec’s successful fetch leaves the stale tracking ref, but its exact live lookup exits 2. Report:
   ```text
   origin/spec-export is missing in acme/codec
   ```
3. Before selecting recovery, prescribe:
   ```sh
   git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md
   ```
   Independent outcomes:
   - **B1:** Prints `7777777777777777777777777777777777777777`: offer `git push -u origin spec-export` from `/work/codec`, then rerun `brainstorming #42`.
   - **B2:** No local branch; prints nothing:
     ```text
     no local branch on this machine holds the leg file; restore origin/spec-export from a clone that still has it and rerun brainstorming #42; nothing is regenerated
     ```
   - **B3:** Unrelated local branch with no file history; prints nothing: same ending as B2, no push offer.
4. Never check out the primary. Stop before companion add, local-ref update, or merge.
5. **Transport branch:** exit 128 with `fatal: unable to access origin` is a command failure. Name acme/codec and the failed lookup with that stderr; do not report absence or run absence recovery.

## C — Membership validation

1. Read declarations from `BASE_SHA`, not the home worktree copy. Without codec’s declaration:
   ```text
   leg acme/codec matches no sibling declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
   ```
2. Independent helper validation branches stop naming the declaration and observed defect: missing `/work/helper`, stored origin `acme/other`, or canonical companion PATH equal to `/work/widget`.
3. A missing last selected checkout prevents creating or syncing **any** companion.

## D — Contract drift and malformed blocks

1. Independent stops:
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/<name>, resolved trees/<name>; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded create: git worktree add <home> -b <branch>, resolved workspace add <home> <branch>; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
2. No silent choice or provisioning. A user-approved repair rewrites and commits the home’s helper Leg block and affected helper companion artifact consistently.
3. Independently, a third block missing repo, branch, or contract stops naming that malformed block and missing field; preserve home. Do not enter ordinary sibling discovery.

## E — Partial provisioning and recovery

1. Home and helper are ready. Codec’s checked-out-elsewhere stop:
   ```text
   branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first.
   Preserved created legs:
   acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
2. On rerun, inspect actual local branch tips and rebase-state directories. Prove home’s published-head ancestry, nonempty first-parent merge-only walk, two parents per entry, second-parent ancestry of `origin/main`, and clean tree. Reuse unchanged:
   ```text
   Base sync recovered: 8888888
   merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
   ```
   No reset or recovery `update-ref`.
3. **Helper unresolved:** after failed resolution/abort, preserve trees and report:
   ```text
   base merge unresolved for acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
   Include the same home/helper preserved inventory. No helper ready report for that failed attempt.
4. After the user’s merge `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999`, repeat the proof; recover without reset and report `Base sync recovered: 9999999`.
5. **Unrelated helper tip:** proof fails for ordinary commit `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`:
   ```text
   local branch spec-export is at aaaaaaa, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (2222222); companion needs the published branch head.
   ```
6. **Codec deletion race:** its provisioning-time repeated live lookup exits 2 despite stale tracking state. Stop before codec writes; run B’s file-scoped check and use B2’s recovery ending. Preserve home/helper.
7. **Race transport failure:** exit 128 is command failure, not absence; preserve the same inventory.

## G — Script-placed helper

1. Read the discovered script’s source. Derive current portable create as `script/worktree create <name> --branch <branch>` from Step 1b discovery—not the built-in default. Recorded home is absent: skip home comparison; equal create passes.
2. Locate `/work/helper-trees/export` by linked branch and verify live checkout/common-dir identity. Reuse it; no another-path stop.
3. **No tree:** verify the script supports existing branches, then invoke its existing-branch form with `NAME=spec-export`. Locate and verify the resulting `/work/helper-trees/export`; no built-in fallback.
4. **Unsupported script:**
   ```text
   cannot provision acme/helper: script/worktree cannot check out existing branch spec-export
   ```
   Stop before local-ref writes or add.
5. **Recorded-home delta:**
   ```text
   contract drift for acme/helper: recorded home: .worktrees/<name>, resolved absent; amend the recorded contract or restore the repo convention, then rerun brainstorming #42
   ```
   Only after user approval, drop home from `/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export/doc/specs/export.md`’s helper Leg block and `/work/helper-trees/export/doc/specs/export.md`; commit both reconciled artifacts.

## F — Gate actions

1. Clean approval **1** requires `Amend-grant: none`, not the requested granting sentence. On home only, persist Engine waves and PR acme/widget#42; make new commit `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`, never amend published history. Verify all three fields. Leave companions untouched; complete brainstorm and invoke writing-plans.
2. Independent shared-Design change: revise to “Keep receipts with pending status”; rewrite and commit the live helper artifact consistently before a fresh summarizer/re-gate. Preserve pinned audit and grant decoding. Infer no second council or approval; use no handoff/resume route.
